label: sequence structure and the intensity curve

scenarios.request: where does this sequence go flat?
scenarios.why: A flat stretch is a run of cuts that change nothing; the structure check finds it across the sequence.
Building names the beat the curve must rise into; the check measures the rise and suggests the stack that makes it.
The intensity is the curve itself, read per shot and per cut, not a mood for one shot.

scenarios.request: the edit lacks contrast in the middle, find it
scenarios.why: Missing contrast between cuts is the flat rule's measure, so it asks for the structure check.

scenarios.request: does the scene peak on the decision?
scenarios.why: Whether the peak lands on a beat is the peak-off-beat rule; the beat named is the one to check against.

scenarios.request: escalate the scene into the confession
scenarios.why: Escalating into a beat asks the curve to rise into it, whatever kind of beat it is.

scenarios.request: chart the tension curve of my cut
scenarios.why: A tension curve over the cut is the intensity curve, so no technique is laid.

scenarios.request: an intense extreme close-up on Mara
scenarios.why: Intense is a mood for one shot, not a question about the curve; the size is the request.
